scope: Qualitative, source-based thematic analysis of tracked TECT-X documentation, code, tests and governance. No independent mathematical proof review or computational rerun.

themes.name: Epistemic control and proof-scope governance
themes.finding: Claim status depends on exact scope, evidence and unclosed proof obligations rather than passing software checks.
themes.open_obligation: External authentication, independent verification and a formal promotion policy remain outside this source audit.

themes.name: Finite computation versus universal proof
themes.finding: A large finite registry and numerical feature scan cannot resolve an all-zero or all-parameter mathematical statement.
themes.open_obligation: Produce a complete analytic finite-to-global argument before any universal promotion.

themes.name: Topological identifiability and experimental controls
themes.finding: Feature mappings can collapse distinct zeta functions and coordinate manipulations can introduce topological artifacts.
themes.open_obligation: Prove invariant descriptors, stability and any analytically meaningful transfer from TDA features to genuine zeta zeros.

themes.name: Adversarial spectral mathematics
themes.finding: Explicit spectral candidates and determinant identities can have provable or documented failures despite matching partial signatures.
themes.open_obligation: Construct and independently verify a fixed self-adjoint arithmetic operator with noncircular all-zero correspondence, if pursuing Hilbert–Pólya.

themes.name: Novelty, provenance and Selmer-infinitude boundary
themes.finding: Existing rank lower bounds, known prior work and a conditional Selmer argument do not prove new unconditional Selmer-3 infinitude.
themes.open_obligation: Complete uniform global descent or an independently proved arithmetic-statistics estimate, with a specialist priority audit.

themes.name: Human review and research-literacy workflows
themes.finding: The curriculum and faculty-review MVP operationalize critique and evidence boundaries without certifying new mathematical results.
themes.open_obligation: Independent participant identity assurance, privacy review and external validation of workflow effectiveness remain open.

evidence.statement: Four zeta families total one million evaluated function variants; only 128 feature points per family receive sampled H0/H1 analysis.
evidence.limitation: Repository-reported results; no independent rerun, zero search, or million-point H1 computation performed by this thematic audit.

evidence.statement: Adaptive cycle-Ihara probes can map distinct functions to identical descriptors.
evidence.limitation: An identifiability counterexample, not a theorem about actual Riemann zeta zeros.

evidence.statement: Coordinate-permutation controls produce artificial H1 features on a declared finite sample.
evidence.limitation: Selected radii, feature normalization and perturbations are not a population-wide statistical result.

evidence.statement: A fixed arithmetic Jacobi candidate has the desired leading counting law but fails the first-zero spectral match.
evidence.limitation: Refutes a particular candidate, not all spectral approaches; this audit does not independently check the proof.

evidence.statement: A parameter-dependent theta-Fredholm determinant matches the classical xi divisor without constraining zero locations.
evidence.limitation: Not a fixed self-adjoint Hilbert–Pólya operator or RH proof; no novelty assessment.

evidence.statement: The selected elliptic-curve progression has documented independent rational-point classes and an n=5 rank-at-least-four obstruction.
evidence.limitation: This audit reviews the claim record, not an independent formal or specialist proof; no uniform Selmer dimension is determined.

evidence.statement: The unconditional infinite Selmer-3 subfamily theorem is open and manuscript submission is blocked.
evidence.limitation: A publication workflow declaration is not a mathematical decision procedure.

evidence.statement: Faculty-review prototype provides invitation-linked reviewers, distinct teaching approvals, and admin adjudication.
evidence.limitation: Local MVP; teaching approval is not mathematical peer review, and reviewer identity is not institutionally verified.

evidence.statement: Standalone six-week curriculum trains finite-versus-universal reasoning and controlled zeta/TDA experiments.
evidence.limitation: A curricular design and tests do not demonstrate learning efficacy without independent educational evaluation.

evidence.statement: Repository provides claim-evidence checks and a fail-closed manuscript readiness gate.
evidence.limitation: Internal consistency checks and state declarations cannot certify external reproduction or mathematical truth.

priorities.action: Maintain a versioned claim-to-evidence thematic register and fail-closed consistency checks.
priorities.acceptance: Referenced files exist; status mirrors retain documented blockers; CI validates the register.

priorities.action: Seek invariant, stable feature maps and an explicit analytic TDA-to-zero transfer theorem before stronger RH claims.
priorities.acceptance: Formal assumptions and proof obligations are written down, independently assessed and not inferred from finite plots.

priorities.action: Resolve full Selmer descent or the thin-family average estimate, with independent novelty review.
priorities.acceptance: A complete, externally scrutinized unconditional theorem rather than a finite-rank certificate.

priorities.action: Package independent rerun scripts, bounded numerical error controls and human review provenance.
priorities.acceptance: Reproduction/identity assertions are backed by distinct independently verified artifacts, not merely self-declared flags.
